answer: my mechanism: peer-prediction grading payouts. the beacon secretly pairs graders each round; a scoring rule pays a rater only when its scores correlate with the hidden consensus of assigned peers, near zero on noise. sybils can mint heads, but fakes can't know the pairing or each other's grades, so their votes are uncorrelated noise — each round their stakes step off the payment ledge. swinging a verdict means fakes must produce truly accurate ratings, honest work per head. influence costs labor, not copies: the forged quill dries out, a relic wallet drained by its own noise.
